about: The economic activities of the EU Taxonomy as in force: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2139 (Annex I climate change mitigation, Annex II adaptation) with the sections Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1214 inserted and the additions and amendments of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2485, and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2486 (Annexes I-IV: water and marine resources, circular economy, pollution prevention and control, biodiversity). Each activity: its printed code (objective abbreviation + section, the Code rule of Annex II to 2021/2178 as replaced by 2023/2486), title, sector, the NACE codes the act itself associates with it (verbatim sentence; indicative — 'could be associated with'), and its category (transitional / enabling) with the verbatim sentence. Captured from the Official Journal texts and independently second-passed; every quote verbatim.

Annex I.quote: The technical screening criteria for determining the conditions under which an economic activity qualifies as contributing substantially to climate change mitigation and for determining whether that economic activity causes no significant harm to any of the other environmental objectives laid down in Article 9 of Regulation (EU) 2020/852 are set out in Annex I to this Regulation.

Annex II.quote: The technical screening criteria for determining the conditions under which an economic activity qualifies as contributing substantially to climate change adaptation and for determining whether that economic activity causes no significant harm to any of the other environmental objectives laid down in Article 9 of Regulation (EU) 2020/852 are set out in Annex II to this Regulation.

code_rule: The Code constitutes the abbreviation of the relevant objective to which the economic activity is eligible to make a substantial contribution, as well as the section number of the activity in the relevant Annex covering the objective, i.e.: Climate Change Mitigation: CCM; Climate Change Adaptation: CCA; Water and Marine Resources: WTR; Circular Economy: CE; Pollution Prevention and Control: PPC; Biodiversity and ecosystems: BIO.
